title: K1 C3 Prospective Mediation-Complete Refinement Falsification Gate
purpose: Freeze the C3 authority obligations and adversarial gate before any C3 implementation exists.
Test whether a deliberately restricted richer implementation profile can be bound to an independently reconstructed C2 bounded model without hidden consequential exits or semantic laundering.
Permit positive authority only when mediation completeness and refinement fidelity are independently established; producer declarations are never sufficient authority.

kernel_invariants.regression_rule_unchanged: A grounded realized pair outside ALLOW is sufficient for REGRESSION/BREAKING.
kernel_invariants.preservation_rule_unchanged: PRESERVATION still requires adequate closure/exhaustiveness, grounding, consequential-cut totality, and REALIZE subset-of ALLOW.
kernel_invariants.unknown_rule_unchanged: Any unresolved authority-relevant uncertainty fails closed to unsupported/unknown rather than safety.

c3_hypothesis.statement: A richer implementation can inherit C2 positive closure authority only if the admitted representation has a closed, independently checkable consequential boundary; every reachable consequential exit is mediated; the mediation/refinement mapping is total and consequence-faithful; and independent verifiers reconstruct the same C2 target behavior from exact authority inputs.
c3_hypothesis.scope_restriction: C3 is intentionally not a proof of arbitrary native-program behavior. The admitted representation/profile must be narrow enough that reachability, effect inventory, and mediation completeness are mechanically checkable.
c3_hypothesis.architectural_intent: Keep K1 and the authority checkers small. Move expressive complexity into non-authoritative producers/frontends whose outputs must survive independent reconstruction.

must_bind_exactly: all finite consequential input/state dimensions required by the profile
exact downstream C2 target identity and authority-relevant limits

in_scope: semantic relabeling/laundering at the mediation boundary
unsupported dynamic behavior inside the admitted profile
mitigated_but_not_magically_eliminated: checker implementation defects, by independent implementations and differential adversarial testing
representation bugs, by exact-byte binding and strict parsing
outside_positive_authority_unless_later_: compromised host operating system or hardware
unrestricted FFI, dynamic loading, reflection, or eval
side channels not represented as K1 consequences

authority_obligations.name: exact_subject_identity
authority_obligations.requirement: Authority binds exact admitted representation bytes and profile version, not a path, name, build label, or producer assertion.

authority_obligations.name: exact_claim_and_c2_binding
authority_obligations.requirement: The bridge binds one exact K1/W0 claim and one exact downstream C2 target/evidence chain; substitution changes authority identity.

authority_obligations.name: closed_world_reachability
authority_obligations.requirement: The admitted profile must make reachable control/effect structure mechanically enumerable or otherwise decidable under a versioned rule; unresolved dynamic reachability cannot receive positive authority.

authority_obligations.name: complete_effect_inventory
authority_obligations.requirement: Every reachable operation capable of a K1 consequence must be classified as mediated, structurally impossible, or unsupported; an unclassified consequential primitive fails closed.

authority_obligations.name: no_unmediated_consequential_path
authority_obligations.requirement: No reachable path may cause a consequence while bypassing the declared mediation boundary.

authority_obligations.name: total_refinement_mapping
authority_obligations.requirement: Every mediated consequential event in the admitted profile maps to a downstream consequence representation; unmapped events cannot be dropped or treated as safe.

authority_obligations.name: non_laundering_refinement
authority_obligations.requirement: The mapping must preserve every distinction relevant to ALLOW. Many-to-one mapping is forbidden unless the verifier independently establishes that the merged source events are equivalent for the bound K1 claim.

authority_obligations.name: consequential_multiplicity_and_order
authority_obligations.requirement: Multiple consequences and ordering are preserved whenever the bound consequence semantics distinguishes them; first-effect-only projection is not closure.

authority_obligations.name: open_consequence_universe
authority_obligations.requirement: Target-native or previously unseen consequence payloads remain representable and cannot be discarded merely because a producer vocabulary lacks a label.

authority_obligations.name: all_variation_accounted
authority_obligations.requirement: State/history, nondeterminism, time, scheduling, environment, and capabilities are either structurally absent from the admitted profile or represented by explicit authority-bound finite dimensions adequate for the claim.

authority_obligations.name: uncertainty_is_not_safety
authority_obligations.requirement: Parse failure, unresolved target, unsupported opcode/feature, analyzer uncertainty, resource exhaustion, or incomplete enumeration yields REJECTED/INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN, never PRESERVED.

authority_obligations.name: independent_reconstruction
authority_obligations.requirement: At least two independently implemented authority checkers must reconstruct authority-relevant subject identity, mediation completeness, refinement result, and downstream binding without trusting producer verdict fields.

authority_obligations.name: downstream_c2_recomputation
authority_obligations.requirement: C2 authority-relevant behavior must be independently recomputed or revalidated under the exact C2 protocol from bound inputs; a producer-supplied C2 PASS or REALIZE relation is insufficient.

authority_obligations.name: domain_non_shrinkage
authority_obligations.requirement: Worlds, boundary slots, slot values, effect classes, and authority-relevant limits are content-bound; omission or shrinkage changes identity and cannot silently preserve authority.

authority_obligations.name: evidence_chain_integrity
authority_obligations.requirement: Claim, subject, mediation specification, profile, C2 target, and checker-visible evidence form an exact digest-linked chain; any mismatch or tamper fails closed.

authority_obligations.name: verifier_disagreement_fails_closed
authority_obligations.requirement: Any authority-relevant disagreement between independent verifiers prevents positive authority until resolved.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: A reachable consequence-producing primitive bypasses the declared mediator.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: No positive C3 authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: One reachable edge into a consequence sink is omitted from the producer effect graph.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Independent reconstruction detects omission or returns incomplete/unknown.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Mapper relabels a source consequence forbidden by the bound claim as an allowed target consequence.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Laundering is detected or the faithful forbidden consequence reaches downstream K1; PRESERVATION is impossible.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Distinct source consequences with different ALLOW status are collapsed to one target label.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Rejected unless independent claim-relative equivalence is established; forbidden distinction cannot disappear.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: A target-native/unrecognized effect class is omitted because the producer vocabulary does not know it.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Unknown effect survives as an open-universe consequence or positive authority fails.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Only the first consequence from a multi-effect execution is exported.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Non-exhaustive projection is detected; no positive authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: An allowed effect is followed by a forbidden effect which the producer drops.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Forbidden effect must surface downstream or positive authority fails.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: A consequence occurs after the apparent main computation returns.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Profile rejects unsupported asynchronous escape or models it explicitly; no silent preservation.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Spawned child performs a consequence outside the mediator.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Unsupported spawn/child capability prevents positive authority unless explicitly closed by the admitted profile.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: An inherited file descriptor/handle/capability reaches a sink outside the declared boundary.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Capability escape is detected or profile is unsupported.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: FFI/native hostcall introduces a consequential exit not represented by the profile.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Fail closed; no arbitrary-FFI positive authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Runtime-loaded code introduces an unenumerated consequence path.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Fail closed unless exact loaded code is authority-bound and within a later explicitly qualified profile.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Reflection/eval changes reachable consequential operations after static producer analysis.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Unsupported dynamic reachability prevents positive authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: mmap/shared memory communicates a consequential state mutation outside mediation.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Rejected/unsupported unless explicitly represented as a mediated consequence.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Thread, callback, or task reaches a consequential sink not present in the producer's main-path model.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: No positive authority unless the concurrency form is inside an explicitly closed admitted profile.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Signal/interrupt handler creates a hidden consequential path.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Unsupported signal behavior fails closed.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Behavior depends on clock/time not included in the finite authority boundary.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Detected as unsupported variation or explicitly modeled; no sampling-based closure.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Behavior depends on RNG/nondeterminism absent from the bound domain.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Detected as unsupported variation or explicitly finite-modeled; no single-run determinism assumption.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Environment/configuration value changes a consequence but is absent from the authority boundary.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Positive authority fails until the dimension is structurally absent or explicitly bound.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Prior execution state/history changes reachable consequences but producer resets or omits it.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: History dependence is detected/represented or authority is incomplete.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: One admitted K1 world is omitted from the bridge domain.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Exact identity mismatch or domain-coverage failure; no positive authority for the original claim.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: One finite slot/value/state case is omitted from the downstream C2 boundary.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Exact identity/coverage mismatch; no silent preservation.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Implementation/profile representation bytes are modified while retaining producer metadata.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Subject identity changes and stale authority is invalid.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Mediation/refinement specification is changed after evidence generation.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Digest chain mismatch or new authority identity; stale PASS cannot transfer.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: C2 program, boundary, gas/resource limit, or target identity differs from the bound downstream subject.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Independent C2 revalidation detects mismatch; no positive authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: NUL/CR/tab, duplicate identifiers, malformed encoding, or equivalent syntax ambiguity causes producer/verifier interpretation divergence.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Strict parser rejection or verifier disagreement; never PRESERVED.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Producer edits submitted REALIZE to remove a forbidden pair.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Submitted relation has no authority; independent reconstruction restores the pair or rejects.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Producer sets complete=true or equivalent despite an incomplete mediation/effect inventory.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Flag is ignored for authority; independent checker denies closure.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Producer supplies a stale or fabricated target/subject identifier.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Verifier recomputes identity and detects mismatch.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Bytes analyzed for mediation completeness differ from bytes used to derive downstream behavior.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Content-binding mismatch; no positive authority.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Producer marks a reachable consequential primitive unreachable to exclude it from the inventory.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: Independent reachability reconstruction disagrees or exposes path; positive authority fails.

precommitted_falsification_vectors.attack: Two authority checkers disagree on subject identity, reachability/effect inventory, refinement relation, or downstream binding.
precommitted_falsification_vectors.required_result: No positive authority regardless of producer verdict.

positive_controls.required_result: A small closed admitted profile with all consequences mediated and faithfully mapped remains eligible for downstream C2 evaluation; C3 alone still does not assert PRESERVATION.
Semantically set-like ordering differences in worlds/domains/inventory produce the same authority identity and reconstructed relation where the protocol defines them as representation-invariant.
An arbitrary target-native consequence payload survives refinement without being dropped for lack of a friendly label.
A fully mediated but forbidden consequence is faithfully delivered to downstream K1/C2, causing preservation denial or regression rather than mapper rejection/laundering.
Two or more consequential outputs survive with all claim-relevant distinctions/order intact; no first-effect truncation.
Mutating advisory producer verdict/complete/REALIZE fields cannot create, remove, or transfer authority when exact authority inputs are unchanged.

gate_semantics.attack_vector_pass: The mutation cannot obtain positive C3 authority. Where the correct semantics is a faithful forbidden consequence, success additionally requires that the forbidden consequence survives to downstream K1/C2 rather than being hidden by rejection or relabeling.
gate_semantics.positive_control_pass: The control is not spuriously rejected and all required authority-relevant information survives independent reconstruction.
gate_semantics.unknown_is_not_failure_of_fail_closed_de: UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/REJECTED is the required safe result for unresolved positive authority, but may not be used to hide a forbidden effect in controls that require faithful propagation.
gate_semantics.no_sampling_substitute: Replay count, branch coverage, test coverage, or repeated clean execution is diagnostic only and cannot substitute for the C3 authority obligations.

qualification_rule.any_protocol_change_after_implementation: new protocol version plus fresh prospective attack qualification; no retroactive weakening of this gate

no_claim_boundary: No claim that this prospective file proves implementation mediation completeness.
No claim that C3 currently creates a production proof kind.
No claim that C3 currently grants K1 PRESERVATION.
No claim of arbitrary native-program closure or arbitrary-language compiler correctness.
No claim that source-level inspection alone binds executed behavior.
No claim of sandbox security against hostile arbitrary code.
No claim of host OS, hardware, remote, or supply-chain attestation.
No claim of unbounded liveness, deadline, concurrency, or probabilistic completeness.
No claim about side channels unless they are explicitly represented as K1 consequences in a later versioned profile.
No change to K1 semantic primitives, P1/B1 negative authority, or C2 scope.

next_step_allowed_by_this_freeze.instruction: Only after this prospective gate is committed may C3 admitted-profile semantics and independent reconstruction/checker implementations be added.
next_step_allowed_by_this_freeze.first_implementation_priority: Choose the smallest richer-than-C2 representation in which consequential exits and reachability can actually be independently closed; do not start from arbitrary native binaries.
next_step_allowed_by_this_freeze.success_standard: Earn a narrow positive refinement bridge by construction and falsification, not by declaring a broad implementation model complete.
